items.title: Roger Kellaway interviewed by Monk Rowe, Los Angeles, California, February 14, 1999
items.q: So it’s a duet with Paula Cole. She came in and sang beautifully

ctx.x: So it’s a duet with Paula Cole. She came in and sang beautifully, and I still really don’t know who she is musically. I know she’s a big star and she got five Grammys last year and all of that. But in our meeting she wanted me to dictate what I wanted her to sing, in solfege. So right away my opinion about here shot up about 25 points.
That she even knew the word, right?
